<thought>We need to generate up to 40 nitride compositions, retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition with energy above hull ≤ 0.3 eV/atom, and then consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset. We'll use the `batch_retrieve_polymorphs` tool to fetch the data, list the created files, build the required mapping, and finally call `consolidate_polymorph_datasets`. The final answer will be the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "BN", "Si3N4", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN",
        "VN", "NbN", "TaN", "ScN", "YN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2", "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2",
        "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Zn3N2", "Cd3N2", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN", "CuN",
        "PbN", "SnN", "GeN", "SiN", "B4N", "Al3N", "Ga3N", "In3N", "Ti3N2",
        "Zr3N2", "Hf3N2", "Cr3N2", "Mo3N2"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_1/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
